  public void updateScore(final Player player, final Piece piece, final Move move)
  {
    int dx = Math.abs(move.getDestination().getX() - move.getSource().getX());
    int dy = Math.abs(move.getDestination().getY() - move.getSource().getY());
    int manhattanDistance = dx + dy;
    player.setScore(player.getScore() + manhattanDistance);
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->

    board[move.getSource().getX()][move.getSource().getY()] = null;
    board[move.getDestination().getX()][move.getDestination().getY()] = piece;
    setNumMoves(getNumMoves() + 1);
  }

   * Related Classes: Player, Piece, Move, Place, Knight, Archer
   * Input: player (Player): the player whose available moves to retrieve.
   * Output: List<Move>: list of all legal moves for the player.
   * Pre-condition: player is one of the players in the game.
   * Post-condition: Returns the union of all legal moves from all pieces belonging to the player.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public EList<Move> getAvailableMoves(final Player player)
  {
    EList<Move> moves = new BasicEList<Move>();
    int size = getConfiguration().getSize();
    for (int x = 0; x < size; x++) {
      for (int y = 0; y < size; y++) {
        Piece piece = getPiece(x, y);
        if (piece != null && piece.getPlayer() == player) {
          Place place = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createPlace();
          place.setX(x);
          place.setY(y);
          moves.addAll(piece.getAvailableMoves(this, place));

      }

      } else {
        setCurrentPlayer(players.get(0));
      }
      setNumMoves(getNumMoves() + 1);
    }

   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Determines the winner of the game based on the last move and the current board state.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If game.numMoves < configuration.numMovesProtection, return null (no winner during protection).
   *   2. Check win condition 1: If lastPiece is a Knight and lastMove.source equals centralPlace and lastMove.destination does not equal centralPlace:
   *      - Return lastPlayer.
   *   3. Check win condition 2: Count pieces of each player on the board.

   *   4. If no win condition is met, return null.

  public Player getWinner(final Player lastPlayer, final Piece lastPiece, final Move lastMove)
  {
    if (getNumMoves() < getConfiguration().getNumMovesProtection()) {
      return null;
    }
    if (lastPiece instanceof Knight
        && lastMove.getSource().getX() == getConfiguration().getCentralPlace().getX()
        && lastMove.getSource().getY() == getConfiguration().getCentralPlace().getY()
        && (lastMove.getDestination().getX() != getConfiguration().getCentralPlace().getX()
            || lastMove.getDestination().getY() != getConfiguration().getCentralPlace().getY())) {
      return lastPlayer;
    }
    int size = getConfiguration().getSize();
    Player player1 = getConfiguration().getPlayers().get(0);
    Player player2 = getConfiguration().getPlayers().get(1);
    int count1 = 0;
    int count2 = 0;
    for (int x = 0; x < size; x++) {
      for (int y = 0; y < size; y++) {
        Piece piece = getPiece(x, y);
        if (piece != null) {
          if (piece.getPlayer() == player1) {
            count1++;
          } else if (piece.getPlayer() == player2) {
            count2++;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    if (count1 > 0 && count2 == 0) {
      return player1;
    }
    if (count2 > 0 && count1 == 0) {
      return player2;
    }
    return null;
  }

        Player currentPlayer = getCurrentPlayer();
        Player otherPlayer = getConfiguration().getPlayers().get(1);
        if (currentPlayer.getScore() > otherPlayer.getScore()) {
          return currentPlayer;
        } else if (otherPlayer.getScore() > currentPlayer.getScore()) {
          return otherPlayer;
        } else {
          return currentPlayer;
        }
      }
      Player currentPlayer = getCurrentPlayer();
      Move move = currentPlayer.nextMove(this, availableMoves);
      Piece piece = getPiece(move.getSource());
      movePiece(move);
      updateScore(currentPlayer, piece, move);
      Player winner = getWinner(currentPlayer, piece, move);
      if (winner != null) {
        return winner;
      }
      // Switch currentPlayer to the other player
      EList<Player> players = getConfiguration().getPlayers();
      if (currentPlayer == players.get(0)) {
        setCurrentPlayer(players.get(1));
      } else {
        setCurrentPlayer(players.get(0));
      }
      setNumMoves(getNumMoves() + 1);
    }
  }

  public Player getWinner(final Player lastPlayer, final Piece lastPiece, final Move lastMove)
  {
    if (getNumMoves() < getConfiguration().getNumMovesProtection()) {
      return null;
    }
    // Check win condition 1: Knight leaving centralPlace
    if (lastPiece instanceof Knight && 
        lastMove.getSource().getX() == getConfiguration().getCentralPlace().getX() &&
        lastMove.getSource().getY() == getConfiguration().getCentralPlace().getY() &&
        (lastMove.getDestination().getX() != getConfiguration().getCentralPlace().getX() ||
         lastMove.getDestination().getY() != getConfiguration().getCentralPlace().getY())) {
      return lastPlayer;
    }
    // Check win condition 2: Count pieces of each player
    int size = getConfiguration().getSize();
    Player player1 = getConfiguration().getPlayers().get(0);
    Player player2 = getConfiguration().getPlayers().get(1);
    int count1 = 0;
    int count2 = 0;
    for (int x = 0; x < size; x++) {
      for (int y = 0; y < size; y++) {
        Piece p = getPiece(x, y);
        if (p != null) {
          if (p.getPlayer() == player1) {
            count1++;
          } else if (p.getPlayer() == player2) {
            count2++;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    if (count1 > 0 && count2 == 0) {
      return player1;
    }
    if (count2 > 0 && count1 == 0) {
      return player2;
    }
    return null;
  }

  public void updateScore(final Player player, final Piece piece, final Move move)
  {
    int dx = Math.abs(move.getDestination().getX() - move.getSource().getX());
    int dy = Math.abs(move.getDestination().getY() - move.getSource().getY());
    int manhattanDistance = dx + dy;
    player.setScore(player.getScore() + manhattanDistance);
  }

  public void movePiece(final Move move)
  {
    Piece piece = getPiece(move.getSource());
    Piece[][] board = getBoard();
    board[move.getSource().getX()][move.getSource().getY()] = null;
    board[move.getDestination().getX()][move.getDestination().getY()] = piece;
    setNumMoves(getNumMoves() + 1);
  }

  public EList<Move> getAvailableMoves(final Player player)
  {
    EList<Move> moves = new BasicEList<Move>();
    int size = getConfiguration().getSize();
    for (int x = 0; x < size; x++) {
      for (int y = 0; y < size; y++) {
        Piece piece = getPiece(x, y);
        if (piece != null && piece.getPlayer() == player) {
          moves.addAll(piece.getAvailableMoves(this, new Place(x, y)));
        }
      }
    }
    return moves;
  }

   * Algorithm:

   *   3. Calculate manhattanDistance = dx + dy.
   *   4. Add manhattanDistance to player.score.
   * Related Features: player.score

  public void updateScore(final Player player, final Piece piece, final Move move)
  {
    int dx = Math.abs(move.getDestination().getX() - move.getSource().getX());
    int dy = Math.abs(move.getDestination().getY() - move.getSource().getY());
    int manhattanDistance = dx + dy;
    player.setScore(player.getScore() + manhattanDistance);
  }

  public EList<Move> getAvailableMoves(final Player player)
  {
    EList<Move> moves = new BasicEList<Move>();
    int size = getConfiguration().getSize();
    for (int x = 0; x < size; x++) {
      for (int y = 0; y < size; y++) {
        Piece piece = getPiece(x, y);
        if (piece != null && piece.getPlayer() == player) {
          Place place = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createPlace();
          place.setX(x);
          place.setY(y);
          moves.addAll(piece.getAvailableMoves(this, place));
        }
      }
    }
    return moves;
  }

```java
package edu.pa20;

import org.eclipse.emm.common.util.EList;
import org.eclipse.emm.common.util.BasicEList;
import org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EClass;

public class JesonMor extends Game
{
  protected JesonMor() { ... /* omitted */ }

  @Override
  protected EClass eStaticClass() { ... /* omitted */ }

  public Player start()
  {
    // Algorithm from docstring
    setCurrentPlayer(getConfiguration().getPlayers().get(0));
    while (true) {
      refreshOutput();
      EList<Move> availableMoves = getAvailableMoves(getCurrentPlayer());
      if (availableMoves.isEmpty()) {
        Player currentPlayer = getCurrentPlayer();
        Player otherPlayer = getConfiguration().getPlayers().get(1);
        if (currentPlayer.getScore() > otherPlayer.getScore()) {
          return currentPlayer;
        } else if (otherPlayer.getScore() > currentPlayer.getScore()) {
          return otherPlayer;
        } else {
          return currentPlayer;
        }
      }
      Player currentPlayer = getCurrentPlayer();
      Move move = currentPlayer.nextMove(this, availableMoves);
      Piece piece = getPiece(move.getSource());
      movePiece(move);
      updateScore(currentPlayer, piece, move);
      Player winner = getWinner(currentPlayer, piece, move);
      if (winner != null) {
        return winner;
      }
      // Switch currentPlayer to the other player
      EList<Player> players = getConfiguration().getPlayers();
      if (currentPlayer == players.get(0)) {
        setCurrentPlayer(players.get(1));
      } else {
        setCurrentPlayer(players.get(0));
      }
      setNumMoves(getNumMoves() + 1);
    }
  }

  public Player getWinner(final Player lastPlayer, final Piece lastPiece, final Move lastMove)
  {
    if (getNumMoves() < getConfiguration().getNumMovesProtection()) {
      return null;
    }
    // Check win condition 1: Knight leaving centralPlace
    if (lastPiece instanceof Knight && 
        lastMove.getSource().getX() == getConfiguration().getCentralPlace().getX() &&
        lastMove.getSource().getY() == getConfiguration().getCentralPlace().getY() &&
        (lastMove.getDestination().getX() != getConfiguration().getCentralPlace().getX() ||
         lastMove.getDestination().getY() != getConfiguration().getCentralPlace().getY())) {
      return lastPlayer;
    }
    // Check win condition 2: Count pieces of each player
    int size = getConfiguration().getSize();
    Player player1 = getConfiguration().getPlayers().get(0);
    Player player2 = getConfiguration().getPlayers().get(1);
    int count1 = 0;
    int count2 = 0;
    for (int x = 0; x < size; x++) {
      for (int y = 0; y < size; y++) {
        Piece p = getPiece(x, y);
        if (p != null) {
          if (p.getPlayer() == player1) {
            count1++;
          } else if (p.getPlayer() == player2) {
            count2++;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    if (count1 > 0 && count2 == 0) {
      return player1;
    }
    if (count2 > 0 && count1 == 0) {
      return player2;
    }
    return null;
  }

  public void updateScore(final Player player, final Piece piece, final Move move)
  {
    int dx = Math.abs(move.getDestination().getX() - move.getSource().getX());
    int dy = Math.abs(move.getDestination().getY() - move.getSource().getY());
    int manhattanDistance = dx + dy;
    player.setScore(player.getScore() + manhattanDistance);
  }

  public void movePiece(final Move move)
  {
    Piece piece = getPiece(move.getSource());
    Piece[][] board = getBoard();
    board[move.getSource().getX()][move.getSource().getY()] = null;
    board[move.getDestination().getX()][move.getDestination().getY()] = piece;
    setNumMoves(getNumMoves() + 1);
  }

  public EList<Move> getAvailableMoves(final Player player)
  {
    EList<Move> moves = new BasicEList<Move>();
    int size = getConfiguration().getSize();
    for (int x = 0; x < size; x++) {
      for (int y = 0; y < size; y++) {
        Piece piece = getPiece(x, y);
        if (piece != null && piece.getPlayer() == player) {
          moves.addAll(piece.getAvailableMoves(this, new Place(x, y)));
        }
      }
    }
    return moves;
  }
}

        }

      for (int y = 0; y < size; y++) {
        Piece piece = getPiece(x, y);

          Place place = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createPlace();
          place.setX(x);
          place.setY(y);

      }
    }
    return moves;

  public EList<Move> getAvailableMoves(final Player player)

```java
public Move nextMove(final Game game, final EList<Move> availableMoves)
{
    Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
    int size = game.getConfiguration().getSize();
    
    while (true) {
        // a. Print the list of available moves (optional)
        System.out.println("Available moves:");
        for (int i = 0; i < availableMoves.size(); i++) {
            Move m = availableMoves.get(i);
            System.out.println((i + 1) + ": " + formatMove(m));
        }
        
        // b. Prompt the user
        System.out.print("Enter your move (source->destination): ");
        
        // c. Read user input
        String input = scanner.nextLine().trim();
        
        // d. Parse the input string
        String[] parts = input.split("->");
        if (parts.length != 2) {
            System.out.println("Invalid format. Please use source->destination (e.g., a1->a2).");
            continue;
        }
        
        // Parse source
        String srcStr = parts[0].trim();
        String destStr = parts[1].trim();
        
        if (srcStr.length() < 2 || destStr.length() < 2) {
            System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
            continue;
        }
        
        char srcColChar = srcStr.charAt(0);
        char destColChar = destStr.charAt(0);
        
        String srcRowStr = srcStr.substring(1);
        String destRowStr = destStr.substring(1);
        
        // Validate column letters
        if (srcColChar < 'a' || srcColChar >= 'a' + size || destColChar < 'a' || destColChar >= 'a' + size) {
            System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
            continue;
        }
        
        int srcX = srcColChar - 'a';
        int destX = destColChar - 'a';
        
        int srcY, destY;
        try {
            srcY = Integer.parseInt(srcRowStr) - 1;
            destY = Integer.parseInt(destRowStr) - 1;
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
            continue;
        }
        
        // Validate row numbers
        if (srcY < 0 || srcY >= size || destY < 0 || destY >= size) {
            System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
            continue;
        }
        
        // e. Create Move object
        Place source = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createPlace();
        source.setX(srcX);
        source.setY(srcY);
        
        Place destination = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createPlace();
        destination.setX(destX);
        destination.setY(destY);
        
        Move candidateMove = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createMove();
        candidateMove.setSource(source);
        candidateMove.setDestination(destination);
        
        // f. Check if this Move exists in availableMoves
        for (Move availableMove : availableMoves) {
            if (availableMove.equals(candidateMove)) {
                // g. Return the matching Move
                return availableMove;
            }
        }
        
        // h. If not found
        System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
    }
}

```java
public Move nextMove(final Game game, final EList<Move> availableMoves)
{
    Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
    int size = game.getConfiguration().getSize();
    
    while (true) {
        // a. Print the list of available moves (optional)
        System.out.println("Available moves:");
        for (int i = 0; i < availableMoves.size(); i++) {
            Move m = availableMoves.get(i);
            System.out.println((i + 1) + ": " + formatMove(m));
        }
        
        // b. Prompt the user
        System.out.print("Enter your move (source->destination): ");
        
        // c. Read user input
        String input = scanner.nextLine().trim();
        
        // d. Parse the input string
        String[] parts = input.split("->");
        if (parts.length != 2) {
            System.out.println("Invalid format. Please use source->destination (e.g., a1->a2).");
            continue;
        }
        
        // Parse source
        String srcStr = parts[0].trim();
        String destStr = parts[1].trim();
        
        if (srcStr.length() < 2 || destStr.length() < 2) {
            System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
            continue;
        }
        
        char srcColChar = srcStr.charAt(0);
        char destColChar = destStr.charAt(0);
        
        String srcRowStr = srcStr.substring(1);
        String destRowStr = destStr.substring(1);
        
        // Validate column letters
        if (srcColChar < 'a' || srcColChar >= 'a' + size || destColChar < 'a' || destColChar >= 'a' + size) {
            System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
            continue;
        }
        
        int srcX = srcColChar - 'a';
        int destX = destColChar - 'a';
        
        int srcY, destY;
        try {
            srcY = Integer.parseInt(srcRowStr) - 1;
            destY = Integer.parseInt(destRowStr) - 1;
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
            continue;
        }
        
        // Validate row numbers
        if (srcY < 0 || srcY >= size || destY < 0 || destY >= size) {
            System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
            continue;
        }
        
        // e. Create Move object
        Place source = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createPlace();
        source.setX(srcX);
        source.setY(srcY);
        
        Place destination = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createPlace();
        destination.setX(destX);
        destination.setY(destY);
        
        Move candidateMove = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createMove();
        candidateMove.setSource(source);
        candidateMove.setDestination(destination);
        
        // f. Check if this Move exists in availableMoves
        for (Move availableMove : availableMoves) {
            if (availableMove.equals(candidateMove)) {
                // g. Return the matching Move
                return availableMove;
            }
        }
        
        // h. If not found
        System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
    }
}

```java
public Move nextMove(final Game game, final EList<Move> availableMoves)
{
    Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
    int size = game.getConfiguration().getSize();
    
    while (true) {
        // a. Print the list of available moves (optional)
        System.out.println("Available moves:");
        for (int i = 0; i < availableMoves.size(); i++) {
            Move m = availableMoves.get(i);
            System.out.println((i + 1) + ": " + formatMove(m));
        }
        
        // b. Prompt the user
        System.out.print("Enter your move (source->destination): ");
        
        // c. Read user input
        String input = scanner.nextLine().trim();
        
        // d. Parse the input string
        String[] parts = input.split("->");
        if (parts.length != 2) {
            System.out.println("Invalid format. Please use source->destination (e.g., a1->a2).");
            continue;
        }
        
        // Parse source
        String srcStr = parts[0].trim();
        String destStr = parts[1].trim();
        
        if (srcStr.length() < 2 || destStr.length() < 2) {
            System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
            continue;
        }
        
        char srcColChar = srcStr.charAt(0);
        char destColChar = destStr.charAt(0);
        
        String srcRowStr = srcStr.substring(1);
        String destRowStr = destStr.substring(1);
        
        // Validate column letters
        if (srcColChar < 'a' || srcColChar >= 'a' + size || destColChar < 'a' || destColChar >= 'a' + size) {
            System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
            continue;
        }
        
        int srcX = srcColChar - 'a';
        int destX = destColChar - 'a';
        
        int srcY, destY;
        try {
            srcY = Integer.parseInt(srcRowStr) - 1;
            destY = Integer.parseInt(destRowStr) - 1;
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
            continue;
        }
        
        // Validate row numbers
        if (srcY < 0 || srcY >= size || destY < 0 || destY >= size) {
            System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
            continue;
        }
        
        // e. Create Move object
        Place source = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createPlace();
        source.setX(srcX);
        source.setY(srcY);
        
        Place destination = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createPlace();
        destination.setX(destX);
        destination.setY(destY);
        
        Move candidateMove = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createMove();
        candidateMove.setSource(source);
        candidateMove.setDestination(destination);
        
        // f. Check if this Move exists in availableMoves
        for (Move availableMove : availableMoves) {
            if (availableMove.equals(candidateMove)) {
                // g. Return the matching Move
                return availableMove;
            }
        }
        
        // h. If not found
        System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
    }
}

      // b. Prompt the user
      System.out.print("Enter your move (source->destination): ");
      
      // c. Read user input as a string
      String input = scanner.nextLine().trim();
      
      // d.i. Split by "->"
      String[] parts = input.split("->");
      if (parts.length != 2) {
        System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
        continue;
      }
      
      String srcStr = parts[0].trim();
      String destStr = parts[1].trim();
      
      // Validate length
      if (srcStr.length() < 2 || destStr.length() < 2) {
        System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
        continue;
      }
      
      // d.ii. Parse source
      char srcColChar = srcStr.charAt(0);
      String srcRowStr = srcStr.substring(1);
      
      // Validate column letter
      if (srcColChar < 'a' || srcColChar >= 'a' + size) {
        System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
        continue;
      }
      int srcX = srcColChar - 'a';
      
      int srcY;
      try {
        srcY = Integer.parseInt(srcRowStr) - 1;
      } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
        System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
        continue;
      }
      
      // Validate row number
      if (srcY < 0 || srcY >= size) {
        System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
        continue;
      }
      
      // d.iii. Parse destination
      char destColChar = destStr.charAt(0);
      String destRowStr = destStr.substring(1);
      
      // Validate column letter
      if (destColChar < 'a' || destColChar >= 'a' + size) {
        System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
        continue;
      }
      int destX = destColChar - 'a';
      
      int destY;
      try {
        destY = Integer.parseInt(destRowStr) - 1;
      } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
        System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
        continue;
      }
      
      // Validate row number
      if (destY < 0 || destY >= size) {
        System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
        continue;
      }
      
      // e. Create a Move object with parsed source and destination
      Place source = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createPlace();
      source.setX(srcX);
      source.setY(srcY);
      
      Place destination = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createPlace();
      destination.setX(destX);
      destination.setY(destY);
      
      Move candidateMove = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createMove();
      candidateMove.setSource(source);
      candidateMove.setDestination(destination);
      
      // f. Check if this Move exists in availableMoves (using equal)
      for (Move availableMove : availableMoves) {
        if (availableMove.equal(candidateMove)) {
          // g. Return the matching Move from availableMoves
          return availableMove;
        }
      }
      
      // h. If not found
      System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
    }
  }
  
  private String formatMove(Move move) {
    Place src = move.getSource();
    Place dest = move.getDestination();
    char srcCol = (char) ('a' + src.getX());
    int srcRow = src.getY() + 1;
    char destCol = (char) ('a' + dest.getX());
    int destRow = dest.getY() + 1;
    return srcCol + Integer.toString(srcRow) + "->" + destCol + Integer.toString(destRow);
  }

```java
public Move nextMove(final Game game, final EList<Move> availableMoves)
{
    Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
    int size = game.getConfiguration().getSize();
    
    while (true) {
        // a. Print the list of available moves (optional)
        System.out.println("Available moves:");
        for (int i = 0; i < availableMoves.size(); i++) {
            Move m = availableMoves.get(i);
            System.out.println((i + 1) + ": " + formatMove(m));
        }
        
        // b. Prompt the user
        System.out.print("Enter your move (source->destination): ");
        
        // c. Read user input
        String input = scanner.nextLine().trim();
        
        // d. Parse the input string
        String[] parts = input.split("->");
        if (parts.length != 2) {
            System.out.println("Invalid format. Please use source->destination (e.g., a1->a2).");
            continue;
        }
        
        // Parse source
        String srcStr = parts[0].trim();
        String destStr = parts[1].trim();
        
        if (srcStr.length() < 2 || destStr.length() < 2) {
            System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
            continue;
        }
        
        char srcColChar = srcStr.charAt(0);
        char destColChar = destStr.charAt(0);
        
        String srcRowStr = srcStr.substring(1);
        String destRowStr = destStr.substring(1);
        
        // Validate column letters
        if (srcColChar < 'a' || srcColChar >= 'a' + size || destColChar < 'a' || destColChar >= 'a' + size) {
            System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
            continue;
        }
        
        int srcX = srcColChar - 'a';
        int destX = destColChar - 'a';
        
        int srcY, destY;
        try {
            srcY = Integer.parseInt(srcRowStr) - 1;
            destY = Integer.parseInt(destRowStr) - 1;
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
            continue;
        }
        
        // Validate row numbers
        if (srcY < 0 || srcY >= size || destY < 0 || destY >= size) {
            System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
            continue;
        }
        
        // e. Create Move object
        Place source = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createPlace();
        source.setX(srcX);
        source.setY(srcY);
        
        Place destination = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createPlace();
        destination.setX(destX);
        destination.setY(destY);
        
        Move candidateMove = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createMove();
        candidateMove.setSource(source);
        candidateMove.setDestination(destination);
        
        // f. Check if this Move exists in availableMoves
        for (Move availableMove : availableMoves) {
            if (availableMove.equals(candidateMove)) {
                // g. Return the matching Move
                return availableMove;
            }
        }
        
        // h. If not found
        System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
    }
}

  private String formatMove(Move move) {
    Place src = move.getSource();
    Place dest = move.getDestination();
    char srcCol = (char) ('a' + src.getX());
    int srcRow = src.getY() + 1;

```java
public Move nextMove(final Game game, final EList<Move> availableMoves)
{
    Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
    int size = game.getConfiguration().getSize();
    
    while (true) {
        // a. Print the list of available moves (optional)
        System.out.println("Available moves:");
        for (int i = 0; i < availableMoves.size(); i++) {
            Move m = availableMoves.get(i);
            System.out.println((i + 1) + ": " + formatMove(m));
        }
        
        // b. Prompt the user
        System.out.print("Enter your move (source->destination): ");
        
        // c. Read user input
        String input = scanner.nextLine().trim();
        
        // d. Parse the input string
        String[] parts = input.split("->");
        if (parts.length != 2) {
            System.out.println("Invalid format. Please use source->destination (e.g., a1->a2).");
            continue;
        }
        
        // Parse source
        String srcStr = parts[0].trim();
        String destStr = parts[1].trim();
        
        if (srcStr.length() < 2 || destStr.length() < 2) {
            System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
            continue;
        }
        
        char srcColChar = srcStr.charAt(0);
        char destColChar = destStr.charAt(0);
        
        String srcRowStr = srcStr.substring(1);
        String destRowStr = destStr.substring(1);
        
        // Validate column letters
        if (srcColChar < 'a' || srcColChar >= 'a' + size || destColChar < 'a' || destColChar >= 'a' + size) {
            System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
            continue;
        }
        
        int srcX = srcColChar - 'a';
        int destX = destColChar - 'a';
        
        int srcY, destY;
        try {
            srcY = Integer.parseInt(srcRowStr) - 1;
            destY = Integer.parseInt(destRowStr) - 1;
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
            continue;
        }
        
        // Validate row numbers
        if (srcY < 0 || srcY >= size || destY < 0 || destY >= size) {
            System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
            continue;
        }
        
        // e. Create Move object
        Place source = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createPlace();
        source.setX(srcX);
        source.setY(srcY);
        
        Place destination = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createPlace();
        destination.setX(destX);
        destination.setY(destY);
        
        Move candidateMove = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createMove();
        candidateMove.setSource(source);
        candidateMove.setDestination(destination);
        
        // f. Check if this Move exists in availableMoves
        for (Move availableMove : availableMoves) {
            if (availableMove.equals(candidateMove)) {
                // g. Return the matching Move
                return availableMove;
            }
        }
        
        // h. If not found
        System.out.println("Invalid move. Please try again.");
    }
}

/**
 * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
 * <!-- end-user-doc -->
 * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
 * Summary: Generates all legal moves for a Knight piece from a given source position.
 * Algorithm:
 *   1. Define the 8 L-shaped offsets: (2,1), (2,-1), (-2,1), (-2,-1), (1,2), (1,-2), (-1,2), (-1,-2).
 *   2. For each offset, calculate destination = (source.x + dx, source.y + dy).
 *   3. If destination is within board bounds:
 *      a. Create a candidate Move from source to destination.
 *      b. Apply all global rules (VacantRule, NilMoveRule, OutOfBoundaryRule, OccupiedRule, FirstNMovesProtectionRule).
 *      c. Apply KnightMoveRule and KnightBlockRule.
 *      d. If all rules pass, add the move to the list.
 *   4. Return the list of valid moves.
 * Related Features: board (via Game.getPiece), player (self.player)
 * Related Classes: Game, Move, Place, VacantRule, NilMoveRule, OutOfBoundaryRule, OccupiedRule, FirstNMovesProtectionRule, KnightMoveRule, KnightBlockRule
 * Input: game (Game): the current game state; source (Place): the position of this Knight piece.
 * Output: List<Move>: list of all legal moves for this Knight.
 * Pre-condition: source is a valid position on the board and contains this Knight piece.
 * Post-condition: Returns a list of moves where each move passes all applicable rules.
 * <!-- end-model-doc -->
 * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
 * @generated NOT
 */
public EList<Move> getAvailableMoves(final Game game, final Place source)
{
  EList<Move> result = new BasicEList<Move>();
  
  // 1. Define the 8 L-shaped offsets
  int[][] offsets = {
    {2, 1}, {2, -1}, {-2, 1}, {-2, -1},
    {1, 2}, {1, -2}, {-1, 2}, {-1, -2}
  };
  
  // Get board size
  int size = game.getConfiguration().getSize();
  
  // Create rule instances
  VacantRule vacantRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createVacantRule();
  NilMoveRule nilMoveRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createNilMoveRule();
  OutOfBoundaryRule outOfBoundaryRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createOutOfBoundaryRule();
  OccupiedRule occupiedRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createOccupiedRule();
  FirstNMovesProtectionRule firstNMovesProtectionRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createFirstNMovesProtectionRule();
  KnightMoveRule knightMoveRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createKnightMoveRule();
  KnightBlockRule knightBlockRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createKnightBlockRule();
  
  // 2. For each offset, calculate destination
  for (int[] offset : offsets) {
    int dx = offset[0];
    int dy = offset[1];
    int destX = source.getX() + dx;
    int destY = source.getY() + dy;
    
    // 3. If destination is within board bounds
    if (destX >= 0 && destX < size && destY >= 0 && destY < size) {
      // a. Create a candidate Move from source to destination
      Move move = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createMove();
      move.setSource(source);
      Place destPlace = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createPlace();
      destPlace.setX(destX);
      destPlace.setY(destY);
      move.setDestination(destPlace);
      
      // b. Apply all global rules
      boolean globalRulesPass = true;
      if (!vacantRule.validate(game, move)) globalRulesPass = false;
      if (!nilMoveRule.validate(game, move)) globalRulesPass = false;
      if (!outOfBoundaryRule.validate(game, move)) globalRulesPass = false;
      if (!occupiedRule.validate(game, move)) globalRulesPass = false;
      if (!firstNMovesProtectionRule.validate(game, move)) globalRulesPass = false;
      
      // c. Apply KnightMoveRule and KnightBlockRule
      if (globalRulesPass) {
        if (knightMoveRule.validate(game, move) && knightBlockRule.validate(game, move)) {
          // d. If all rules pass, add the move to the list
          result.add(move);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  // 4. Return the list of valid moves
  return result;
}

  KnightBlockRule knightBlockRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createKnightBlockRule();

      if (!nilMoveRule.validate(game, move)) globalRulesPass = false;

      if (!occupiedRule.validate(game, move)) globalRulesPass = false;

        }
      }
    }
  }

```java
/**
 * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
 * <!-- end-user-doc -->
 * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
 * Summary: Generates all legal moves for a Knight piece from a given source position.
 * Algorithm:
 *   1. Define the 8 L-shaped offsets: (2,1), (2,-1), (-2,1), (-2,-1), (1,2), (1,-2), (-1,2), (-1,-2).
 *   2. For each offset, calculate destination = (source.x + dx, source.y + dy).
 *   3. If destination is within board bounds:
 *      a. Create a candidate Move from source to destination.
 *      b. Apply all global rules (VacantRule, NilMoveRule, OutOfBoundaryRule, OccupiedRule, FirstNMovesProtectionRule).
 *      c. Apply KnightMoveRule and KnightBlockRule.
 *      d. If all rules pass, add the move to the list.
 *   4. Return the list of valid moves.
 * Related Features: board (via Game.getPiece), player (self.player)
 * Related Classes: Game, Move, Place, VacantRule, NilMoveRule, OutOfBoundaryRule, OccupiedRule, FirstNMovesProtectionRule, KnightMoveRule, KnightBlockRule
 * Input: game (Game): the current game state; source (Place): the position of this Knight piece.
 * Output: List<Move>: list of all legal moves for this Knight.
 * Pre-condition: source is a valid position on the board and contains this Knight piece.
 * Post-condition: Returns a list of moves where each move passes all applicable rules.
 * <!-- end-model-doc -->
 * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
 * @generated NOT
 */
public EList<Move> getAvailableMoves(final Game game, final Place source)
{
  EList<Move> result = new BasicEList<Move>();
  
  // 1. Define the 8 L-shaped offsets
  int[][] offsets = {
    {2, 1}, {2, -1}, {-2, 1}, {-2, -1},
    {1, 2}, {1, -2}, {-1, 2}, {-1, -2}
  };
  
  // Get board size
  int size = game.getConfiguration().getSize();
  
  // Create rule instances
  VacantRule vacantRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createVacantRule();
  NilMoveRule nilMoveRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createNilMoveRule();
  OutOfBoundaryRule outOfBoundaryRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createOutOfBoundaryRule();
  OccupiedRule occupiedRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createOccupiedRule();
  FirstNMovesProtectionRule firstNMovesProtectionRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createFirstNMovesProtectionRule();
  KnightMoveRule knightMoveRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createKnightMoveRule();
  KnightBlockRule knightBlockRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createKnightBlockRule();
  
  // 2. For each offset, calculate destination
  for (int[] offset : offsets) {
    int dx = offset[0];
    int dy = offset[1];
    int destX = source.getX() + dx;
    int destY = source.getY() + dy;
    
    // 3. If destination is within board bounds
    if (destX >= 0 && destX < size && destY >= 0 && destY < size) {
      // a. Create a candidate Move from source to destination
      Move move = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createMove();
      move.setSource(source);
      Place destPlace = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createPlace();
      destPlace.setX(destX);
      destPlace.setY(destY);
      move.setDestination(destPlace);
      
      // b. Apply all global rules
      boolean globalRulesPass = true;
      if (!vacantRule.validate(game, move)) globalRulesPass = false;
      if (!nilMoveRule.validate(game, move)) globalRulesPass = false;
      if (!outOfBoundaryRule.validate(game, move)) globalRulesPass = false;
      if (!occupiedRule.validate(game, move)) globalRulesPass = false;
      if (!firstNMovesProtectionRule.validate(game, move)) globalRulesPass = false;
      
      // c. Apply KnightMoveRule and KnightBlockRule
      if (globalRulesPass) {
        if (knightMoveRule.validate(game, move) && knightBlockRule.validate(game, move)) {
          // d. If all rules pass, add the move to the list
          result.add(move);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  // 4. Return the list of valid moves
  return result;
}

/**
 * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
 * <!-- end-user-doc -->
 * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
 * Summary: Generates all legal moves for a Knight piece from a given source position.
 * Algorithm:
 *   1. Define the 8 L-shaped offsets: (2,1), (2,-1), (-2,1), (-2,-1), (1,2), (1,-2), (-1,2), (-1,-2).
 *   2. For each offset, calculate destination = (source.x + dx, source.y + dy).
 *   3. If destination is within board bounds:
 *      a. Create a candidate Move from source to destination.
 *      b. Apply all global rules (VacantRule, NilMoveRule, OutOfBoundaryRule, OccupiedRule, FirstNMovesProtectionRule).
 *      c. Apply KnightMoveRule and KnightBlockRule.
 *      d. If all rules pass, add the move to the list.
 *   4. Return the list of valid moves.
 * Related Features: board (via Game.getPiece), player (self.player)
 * Related Classes: Game, Move, Place, VacantRule, NilMoveRule, OutOfBoundaryRule, OccupiedRule, FirstNMovesProtectionRule, KnightMoveRule, KnightBlockRule
 * Input: game (Game): the current game state; source (Place): the position of this Knight piece.
 * Output: List<Move>: list of all legal moves for this Knight.
 * Pre-condition: source is a valid position on the board and contains this Knight piece.
 * Post-condition: Returns a list of moves where each move passes all applicable rules.
 * <!-- end-model-doc -->
 * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
 * @generated NOT
 */
public EList<Move> getAvailableMoves(final Game game, final Place source)
{
  EList<Move> result = new BasicEList<Move>();
  
  // 1. Define the 8 L-shaped offsets
  int[][] offsets = {
    {2, 1}, {2, -1}, {-2, 1}, {-2, -1},
    {1, 2}, {1, -2}, {-1, 2}, {-1, -2}
  };
  
  // Get board size
  int size = game.getConfiguration().getSize();
  
  // Create rule instances
  VacantRule vacantRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createVacantRule();
  NilMoveRule nilMoveRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createNilMoveRule();
  OutOfBoundaryRule outOfBoundaryRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createOutOfBoundaryRule();
  OccupiedRule occupiedRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createOccupiedRule();
  FirstNMovesProtectionRule firstNMovesProtectionRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createFirstNMovesProtectionRule();
  KnightMoveRule knightMoveRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createKnightMoveRule();
  KnightBlockRule knightBlockRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createKnightBlockRule();
  
  // 2. For each offset, calculate destination
  for (int[] offset : offsets) {
    int dx = offset[0];
    int dy = offset[1];
    int destX = source.getX() + dx;
    int destY = source.getY() + dy;
    
    // 3. If destination is within board bounds
    if (destX >= 0 && destX < size && destY >= 0 && destY < size) {
      // a. Create a candidate Move from source to destination
      Move move = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createMove();
      move.setSource(source);
      Place destPlace = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createPlace();
      destPlace.setX(destX);
      destPlace.setY(destY);
      move.setDestination(destPlace);
      
      // b. Apply all global rules
      boolean globalRulesPass = true;
      if (!vacantRule.validate(game, move)) globalRulesPass = false;
      if (!nilMoveRule.validate(game, move)) globalRulesPass = false;
      if (!outOfBoundaryRule.validate(game, move)) globalRulesPass = false;
      if (!occupiedRule.validate(game, move)) globalRulesPass = false;
      if (!firstNMovesProtectionRule.validate(game, move)) globalRulesPass = false;
      
      // c. Apply KnightMoveRule and KnightBlockRule
      if (globalRulesPass) {
        if (knightMoveRule.validate(game, move) && knightBlockRule.validate(game, move)) {
          // d. If all rules pass, add the move to the list
          result.add(move);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  // 4. Return the list of valid moves
  return result;
}

/**
 * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
 * <!-- end-user-doc -->
 * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
 * Summary: Generates all legal moves for a Knight piece from a given source position.
 * Algorithm:
 *   1. Define the 8 L-shaped offsets: (2,1), (2,-1), (-2,1), (-2,-1), (1,2), (1,-2), (-1,2), (-1,-2).
 *   2. For each offset, calculate destination = (source.x + dx, source.y + dy).
 *   3. If destination is within board bounds:
 *      a. Create a candidate Move from source to destination.
 *      b. Apply all global rules (VacantRule, NilMoveRule, OutOfBoundaryRule, OccupiedRule, FirstNMovesProtectionRule).
 *      c. Apply KnightMoveRule and KnightBlockRule.
 *      d. If all rules pass, add the move to the list.
 *   4. Return the list of valid moves.
 * Related Features: board (via Game.getPiece), player (self.player)
 * Related Classes: Game, Move, Place, VacantRule, NilMoveRule, OutOfBoundaryRule, OccupiedRule, FirstNMovesProtectionRule, KnightMoveRule, KnightBlockRule
 * Input: game (Game): the current game state; source (Place): the position of this Knight piece.
 * Output: List<Move>: list of all legal moves for this Knight.
 * Pre-condition: source is a valid position on the board and contains this Knight piece.
 * Post-condition: Returns a list of moves where each move passes all applicable rules.
 * <!-- end-model-doc -->
 * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
 * @generated NOT
 */
public EList<Move> getAvailableMoves(final Game game, final Place source)
{
  EList<Move> result = new BasicEList<Move>();
  
  // 1. Define the 8 L-shaped offsets
  int[][] offsets = {
    {2, 1}, {2, -1}, {-2, 1}, {-2, -1},
    {1, 2}, {1, -2}, {-1, 2}, {-1, -2}
  };
  
  // Get board size
  int size = game.getConfiguration().getSize();
  
  // Create rule instances
  VacantRule vacantRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createVacantRule();
  NilMoveRule nilMoveRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createNilMoveRule();
  OutOfBoundaryRule outOfBoundaryRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createOutOfBoundaryRule();
  OccupiedRule occupiedRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createOccupiedRule();
  FirstNMovesProtectionRule firstNMovesProtectionRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createFirstNMovesProtectionRule();
  KnightMoveRule knightMoveRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createKnightMoveRule();
  KnightBlockRule knightBlockRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createKnightBlockRule();
  
  // 2. For each offset, calculate destination
  for (int[] offset : offsets) {
    int dx = offset[0];
    int dy = offset[1];
    int destX = source.getX() + dx;
    int destY = source.getY() + dy;
    
    // 3. If destination is within board bounds
    if (destX >= 0 && destX < size && destY >= 0 && destY < size) {
      // a. Create a candidate Move from source to destination
      Move move = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createMove();
      move.setSource(source);
      Place destPlace = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createPlace();
      destPlace.setX(destX);
      destPlace.setY(destY);
      move.setDestination(destPlace);
      
      // b. Apply all global rules
      boolean globalRulesPass = true;
      if (!vacantRule.validate(game, move)) globalRulesPass = false;
      if (!nilMoveRule.validate(game, move)) globalRulesPass = false;
      if (!outOfBoundaryRule.validate(game, move)) globalRulesPass = false;
      if (!occupiedRule.validate(game, move)) globalRulesPass = false;
      if (!firstNMovesProtectionRule.validate(game, move)) globalRulesPass = false;
      
      // c. Apply KnightMoveRule and KnightBlockRule
      if (globalRulesPass) {
        if (knightMoveRule.validate(game, move) && knightBlockRule.validate(game, move)) {

## EMF Coding Style
- When possible, call getter/setter methods to access field values. Do not read/write raw fields derived from the class diagram.
- The getter of a boolean attribute `bv` looks like `isBv()`, e.g., `isIsTrue()` for `isTrue`.
- When possibe, use the creation factory for object creation.
- To create an EList instance, import and use `org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList`.

/**
 * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
 * <!-- end-user-doc -->
 * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
 * Summary: Generates all legal moves for an Archer piece from a given source position.
 * Algorithm:
 *   1. Initialize an empty list of moves.
 *   2. Define the four orthogonal directions: up (0,1), down (0,-1), left (-1,0), right (1,0).
 *   3. For each direction:
 *      a. Iterate step by step from source outward along the direction.
 *      b. For each step, if the square is within bounds:
 *         - If the square is empty, add a non-capturing move to this square.
 *         - If the square has a piece, continue scanning for one more piece:
 *           i. Continue in the same direction, skipping over this piece.
 *           ii. If a second piece is found (any color), add a capturing move to that square.
 *           iii. Stop scanning this direction after processing the second piece.
 *      c. If out of bounds, stop scanning this direction.
 *   4. Apply only the ArcherMoveRule to each candidate move (do NOT apply global rules here; global rules are applied by the caller or by Game.getAvailableMoves).
 *   5. Return the filtered list of valid moves.
 * Related Features: board (via Game.getPiece), player (self.player)
 * Related Classes: Game, Move, Place, ArcherMoveRule
 * Input: game (Game): the current game state; source (Place): the position of this Archer piece.
 * Output: List<Move>: list of all legal moves for this Archer.
 * Pre-condition: source is a valid position on the board and contains this Archer piece.
 * Post-condition: Returns a list of moves where each move passes the ArcherMoveRule.
 * <!-- end-model-doc -->
 * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
 * @generated NOT

public EList<Move> getAvailableMoves(final Game game, final Place source)
{
  // 1. Initialize an empty list of moves
  EList<Move> moves = new BasicEList<Move>();
  
  // 2. Define the four orthogonal directions: up (0,1), down (0,-1), left (-1,0), right (1,0)
  int[][] directions = { {0, 1}, {0, -1}, {-1, 0}, {1, 0} };
  
  // Create the ArcherMoveRule instance for validation
  ArcherMoveRule archerMoveRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createArcherMoveRule();
  
  // 3. For each direction
  for (int[] dir : directions)
  {
    int dx = dir[0];
    int dy = dir[1];
    
    int step = 1;
    boolean skippedPiece = false;
    
    while (true)
    {
      int nx = source.getX() + dx * step;
      int ny = source.getY() + dy * step;
      
      // c. If out of bounds, stop scanning this direction
      int size = game.getConfiguration().getSize();
      if (nx < 0 || nx >= size || ny < 0 || ny >= size)
      {
        break;
      }
      
      // Create the destination place
      Place dest = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createPlace();
      dest.setX(nx);
      dest.setY(ny);
      
      Piece pieceAtDest = game.getPiece(dest);
      
      if (pieceAtDest == null)
      {
        // b. If the square is empty, add a non-capturing move to this square
        if (!skippedPiece)
        {
          Move move = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createMove();
          move.setSource(source);
          move.setDestination(dest);
          moves.add(move);
        }
        else
        {
          // We already skipped a piece, so we don't add moves for empty squares after skipping
        }
      }
      else
      {
        // b. If the square has a piece
        if (!skippedPiece)
        {
          // i. Continue in the same direction, skipping over this piece
          skippedPiece = true;
          // Don't add a move here, just skip
        }
        else
        {
          // ii. If a second piece is found (any color), add a capturing move to that square
          Move move = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createMove();
          move.setSource(source);
          move.setDestination(dest);
          moves.add(move);
          
          // iii. Stop scanning this direction after processing the second piece
          break;
        }
      }
      
      step++;
    }
  }
  
  // 4. Apply only the ArcherMoveRule to each candidate move
  EList<Move> validMoves = new BasicEList<Move>();
  for (Move move : moves)
  {
    if (archerMoveRule.validate(game, move))
    {
      validMoves.add(move);
    }
  }
  
  // 5. Return the filtered list of valid moves
  return validMoves;

```java
/**
 * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
 * <!-- end-user-doc -->
 * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
 * Summary: Generates all legal moves for an Archer piece from a given source position.
 * Algorithm:
 *   1. Initialize an empty list of moves.
 *   2. Define the four orthogonal directions: up (0,1), down (0,-1), left (-1,0), right (1,0).
 *   3. For each direction:
 *      a. Iterate step by step from source outward along the direction.
 *      b. For each step, if the square is within bounds:
 *         - If the square is empty, add a non-capturing move to this square.
 *         - If the square has a piece, continue scanning for one more piece:
 *           i. Continue in the same direction, skipping over this piece.
 *           ii. If a second piece is found (any color), add a capturing move to that square.
 *           iii. Stop scanning this direction after processing the second piece.
 *      c. If out of bounds, stop scanning this direction.
 *   4. Apply only the ArcherMoveRule to each candidate move (do NOT apply global rules here; global rules are applied by the caller or by Game.getAvailableMoves).
 *   5. Return the filtered list of valid moves.
 * Related Features: board (via Game.getPiece), player (self.player)
 * Related Classes: Game, Move, Place, ArcherMoveRule
 * Input: game (Game): the current game state; source (Place): the position of this Archer piece.
 * Output: List<Move>: list of all legal moves for this Archer.
 * Pre-condition: source is a valid position on the board and contains this Archer piece.
 * Post-condition: Returns a list of moves where each move passes the ArcherMoveRule.
 * <!-- end-model-doc -->
 * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
 * @generated NOT
 */
public EList<Move> getAvailableMoves(final Game game, final Place source)
{
  // 1. Initialize an empty list of moves
  EList<Move> moves = new BasicEList<Move>();
  
  // 2. Define the four orthogonal directions: up (0,1), down (0,-1), left (-1,0), right (1,0)
  int[][] directions = { {0, 1}, {0, -1}, {-1, 0}, {1, 0} };
  
  // Create the ArcherMoveRule instance for validation
  ArcherMoveRule archerMoveRule = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createArcherMoveRule();
  
  // 3. For each direction
  for (int[] dir : directions)
  {
    int dx = dir[0];
    int dy = dir[1];
    
    int step = 1;
    boolean skippedPiece = false;
    
    while (true)
    {
      int nx = source.getX() + dx * step;
      int ny = source.getY() + dy * step;
      
      // c. If out of bounds, stop scanning this direction
      int size = game.getConfiguration().getSize();
      if (nx < 0 || nx >= size || ny < 0 || ny >= size)
      {
        break;
      }
      
      // Create the destination place
      Place dest = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createPlace();
      dest.setX(nx);
      dest.setY(ny);
      
      Piece pieceAtDest = game.getPiece(dest);
      
      if (pieceAtDest == null)
      {
        // b. If the square is empty, add a non-capturing move to this square
        if (!skippedPiece)
        {
          Move move = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createMove();
          move.setSource(source);
          move.setDestination(dest);
          moves.add(move);
        }
        else
        {
          // We already skipped a piece, so we don't add moves for empty squares after skipping
        }
      }
      else
      {
        // b. If the square has a piece
        if (!skippedPiece)
        {
          // i. Continue in the same direction, skipping over this piece
          skippedPiece = true;
          // Don't add a move here, just skip
        }
        else
        {
          // ii. If a second piece is found (any color), add a capturing move to that square
          Move move = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createMove();
          move.setSource(source);
          move.setDestination(dest);
          moves.add(move);
          
          // iii. Stop scanning this direction after processing the second piece
          break;
        }
      }
      
      step++;
    }
  }
  
  // 4. Apply only the ArcherMoveRule to each candidate move
  EList<Move> validMoves = new BasicEList<Move>();
  for (Move move : moves)
  {
    if (archerMoveRule.validate(game, move))
    {
      validMoves.add(move);
    }
  }
  
  // 5. Return the filtered list of valid moves
  return validMoves;
}

```java
public EList<Move> getAvailableMoves(final Game game, final Place source)

public boolean validate(final Game game, final Move move)
{
    // Get the piece at the destination
    Piece destPiece = game.getPiece(move.getDestination());
    
    // If destination is empty, return true
    if (destPiece == null) {
      return true;
    }
    
    // Get the piece at the source (the moving piece)
    Piece sourcePiece = game.getPiece(move.getSource());
    
    // If source piece's player equals destination piece's player, it's a friendly piece
    if (sourcePiece.getPlayer() == destPiece.getPlayer()) {
      return false;
    }
    
    // Enemy piece, capture allowed
    return true;
}

```java
public boolean validate(final Game game, final Move move)
{
    Place source = move.getSource();
    Place destination = move.getDestination();
    
    int dx = destination.getX() - source.getX();
    int dy = destination.getY() - source.getY();
    
    int blockX, blockY;
    
    if (Math.abs(dx) == 2 && Math.abs(dy) == 1) {
        blockX = source.getX() + dx / 2;
        blockY = source.getY();
    } else if (Math.abs(dx) == 1 && Math.abs(dy) == 2) {
        blockX = source.getX();
        blockY = source.getY() + dy / 2;
    } else {
        return false;
    }
    
    return game.getPiece(blockX, blockY) == null;
}
```

/**
 * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
 * <!-- end-user-doc -->
 * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
 * Summary: Validates that during the protection phase, no capturing moves are allowed.
 * Algorithm:
 *   1. Get the current number of moves from game.numMoves.
 *   2. If game.numMoves < this.numProtectedMoves:
 *      a. Check if the destination square of the move contains a piece (any color).
 *      b. If it does, return false (capture is prohibited).
 *   3. Return true (protection is not active or move is not a capture).
 * Related Features: board (via Game.getPiece), game.numMoves, configuration.numMovesProtection
 * Related Classes: Game, Move, Place
 * Input: game (Game): the current game state; move (Move): the move to validate.
 * Output: boolean: true if the move is allowed under protection rules, false otherwise.
 * Pre-condition: move.source and move.destination are within board boundaries.
 * Post-condition: Returns false only if protection is active and the move would capture a piece.
 * <!-- end-model-doc -->
 * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
 * @generated NOT
 */
public boolean validate(final Game game, final Move move)
{
    if (game.getNumMoves() < this.numProtectedMoves) {
        Piece piece = game.getPiece(move.getDestination());
        if (piece != null) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Validates that a move conforms to Archer movement rules: orthogonal sliding without jumping for non-capturing moves,
   *          and orthogonal sliding with exactly one piece (screen) between source and destination for capturing moves.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If source and destination are not in the same row (same y) or same column (same x), return false.
   *   2. Determine the direction (dx, dy) from source to destination (each component is -1, 0, or 1).
   *   3. Count the number of pieces between source and destination (exclusive).
   *      - Step from source+dx to destination-dx (exclusive) along the direction.
   *      - For each intermediate square, if it contains a piece, increment count.
   *   4. Get the piece at destination.
   *   5. If destination is empty (non-capturing move):
   *      - Return true if count == 0 (clear path).
   *   6. If destination has a piece (capturing move):
   *      - Return true if count == 1 (exactly one screen piece).
   *   7. Otherwise, return false.
   * Related Features: board (via Game.getPiece)
   * Related Classes: Game, Move, Place
   * Input: game (Game): the current game state; move (Move): the move to validate.
   * Output: boolean: true if the move is valid for an Archer, false otherwise.
   * Pre-condition: source and destination are within board boundaries.
   * Post-condition: Returns true only if the move follows Archer movement rules.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public boolean validate(final Game game, final Move move)
  {
    Place source = move.getSource();
    Place destination = move.getDestination();
    
    int sx = source.getX();
    int sy = source.getY();
    int dx = destination.getX();
    int dy = destination.getY();
    
    // 1. If source and destination are not in the same row (same y) or same column (same x), return false.
    if (sx != dx && sy != dy) {
      return false;
    }
    
    // 2. Determine the direction (dx, dy) from source to destination (each component is -1, 0, or 1).
    int stepX = Integer.compare(dx, sx);
    int stepY = Integer.compare(dy, sy);
    
    // 3. Count the number of pieces between source and destination (exclusive).
    int count = 0;
    int cx = sx + stepX;
    int cy = sy + stepY;
    while (cx != dx || cy != dy) {
      Place intermediate = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createPlace();
      intermediate.setX(cx);
      intermediate.setY(cy);
      if (game.getPiece(intermediate) != null) {
        count++;
      }
      cx += stepX;
      cy += stepY;
    }
    
    // 4. Get the piece at destination.
    Piece destPiece = game.getPiece(destination);
    
    // 5. If destination is empty (non-capturing move):
    if (destPiece == null) {
      // Return true if count == 0 (clear path).
      return count == 0;
    }
    
    // 6. If destination has a piece (capturing move):
    // Return true if count == 1 (exactly one screen piece).
    if (count == 1) {
      return true;
    }
    
    // 7. Otherwise, return false.
    return false;
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Validates that a move conforms to Archer movement rules: orthogonal sliding without jumping for non-capturing moves,
   *          and orthogonal sliding with exactly one piece (screen) between source and destination for capturing moves.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If source and destination are not in the same row (same y) or same column (same x), return false.
   *   2. Determine the direction (dx, dy) from source to destination (each component is -1, 0, or 1).
   *   3. Count the number of pieces between source and destination (exclusive).
   *      - Step from source+dx to destination-dx (exclusive) along the direction.
   *      - For each intermediate square, if it contains a piece, increment count.
   *   4. Get the piece at destination.
   *   5. If destination is empty (non-capturing move):
   *      - Return true if count == 0 (clear path).
   *   6. If destination has a piece (capturing move):
   *      - Return true if count == 1 (exactly one screen piece).
   *   7. Otherwise, return false.
   * Related Features: board (via Game.getPiece)
   * Related Classes: Game, Move, Place
   * Input: game (Game): the current game state; move (Move): the move to validate.
   * Output: boolean: true if the move is valid for an Archer, false otherwise.
   * Pre-condition: source and destination are within board boundaries.
   * Post-condition: Returns true only if the move follows Archer movement rules.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public boolean validate(final Game game, final Move move)
  {
    Place source = move.getSource();
    Place destination = move.getDestination();
    
    int sx = source.getX();
    int sy = source.getY();
    int dx = destination.getX();
    int dy = destination.getY();
    
    // 1. If source and destination are not in the same row (same y) or same column (same x), return false.
    if (sx != dx && sy != dy) {
      return false;
    }
    
    // 2. Determine the direction (dx, dy) from source to destination (each component is -1, 0, or 1).
    int stepX = Integer.compare(dx, sx);
    int stepY = Integer.compare(dy, sy);
    
    // 3. Count the number of pieces between source and destination (exclusive).
    int count = 0;
    int cx = sx + stepX;
    int cy = sy + stepY;
    while (cx != dx || cy != dy) {
      Place intermediate = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createPlace();
      intermediate.setX(cx);
      intermediate.setY(cy);
      if (game.getPiece(intermediate) != null) {
        count++;
      }
      cx += stepX;
      cy += stepY;
    }
    
    // 4. Get the piece at destination.
    Piece destPiece = game.getPiece(destination);
    
    // 5. If destination is empty (non-capturing move):
    if (destPiece == null) {
      // Return true if count == 0 (clear path).
      return count == 0;
    }
    
    // 6. If destination has a piece (capturing move):
    // Return true if count == 1 (exactly one screen piece).
    if (count == 1) {
      return true;
    }
    
    // 7. Otherwise, return false.
    return false;
  }

    // 1. If source and destination are not in the same row or same column, return false.
    if (sx != dx && sy != dy) {
      return false;
    }
    
    // 2. Determine the direction (stepX, stepY) from source to destination.
    int stepX = Integer.compare(dx, sx);
    int stepY = Integer.compare(dy, sy);
    
    // 3. Count the number of pieces between source and destination (exclusive).
    int count = 0;
    int cx = sx + stepX;
    int cy = sy + stepY;
    while (cx != dx || cy != dy) {
      Place intermediate = Pa20Factory.eINSTANCE.createPlace();
      intermediate.setX(cx);
      intermediate.setY(cy);
      if (game.getPiece(intermediate) != null) {
        count++;
      }
      cx += stepX;
      cy += stepY;
    }
    
    // 4. Get the piece at destination.
    Piece destPiece = game.getPiece(destination);
    
    // 5. If destination is empty (non-capturing move):
    if (destPiece == null) {
      return count == 0;
    }
    
    // 6. If destination has a piece (capturing move):
    if (count == 1) {
      return true;
    }
    
    // 7. Otherwise, return false.
    return false;
  }

# Requirement
```text
 Overview
  This project implements a customized board game called JesonMor. It is a turn-based, two-player game played on a
  square grid board of odd size (e.g., 9x9). The game features two types of pieces: Knight and Archer, each with unique
  movement and capture mechanics inspired by Western and Chinese chess. Players take turns moving their pieces,
  accumulating a score based on the Manhattan distance of each move. The game incorporates a rule-based validation
  pipeline to ensure all moves are legal. The game also includes a protection phase for the first N moves where
  capturing is prohibited. The system provides the core game loop, piece movement logic, and rule validations.
  
  Functional Requirements
  Game Control and Loop (JesonMor)
  Game Initialization: The game starts by loading a Configuration which provides the board size (must be odd), initial
  piece placements, players, central place (located at size/2, size/2), and the number of protected moves.
  Turn-Based Execution: Implement a continuous game loop where players take turns sequentially. In each turn, fetch the
  available moves for the current player, prompt the player to make a choice (via Player.nextMove), execute the move,
  update the player's score, and refresh the console output.
  Move Execution: When a move is executed, the piece at the source square must be moved to the destination square on the
   2D board array. The source square becomes empty (null).
  Score Calculation: After a successful move, the current player's score increases by the Manhattan distance between the
   source and destination squares. A move is executed and scored only if it passes all applicable rules; otherwise the board state and scores remain
  unchanged for that attempt.
  Win Condition: After each move, evaluate if a player has won. Protection is active when
  game.numMoves < numMovesProtection (strictly less than); no winner can be declared during protection.
  Once game.numMoves >= numMovesProtection, protection ends and a player wins
   if either:
  1. A Knight leaves the central square (source is central place and destination is not central place), or
  2. Only one player's pieces remain on the board (all opponent pieces have been captured).
  Additionally, if a player has no available moves on their turn, the game ends and the winner is decided by score
  comparison: the player with higher score wins; if scores are equal, the current player wins.
  Piece Movement Logic (Knight and Archer)
  Knight: Moves in an L shape (two squares in one direction, one in the orthogonal direction). However, unlike Western
  chess, it can be blocked by an adjacent piece in its primary direction of movement (similar to the Horse in Chinese
  chess). Specifically, if the Knight moves 2 squares horizontally and 1 square vertically, the blocking square is at
  ((source.x + destination.x) / 2, source.y); if it moves 1 square horizontally and 2 squares vertically, the blocking
  square is at (source.x, (source.y + destination.y) / 2). The move is invalid if any piece occupies this intermediate
  square.
  Archer: Moves any distance orthogonally without jumping. For non-capturing moves, the path between source and
  destination must be completely clear (no pieces in between). For capturing moves, there must be exactly one piece (of
  any color) between the source and destination, which serves as the "screen" or "mount" for the capture (similar to the
   Cannon in Chinese chess).
  Move Generation: Each piece's getAvailableMoves(game, source) method is responsible
  for returning the final list of legal moves for that piece. It must apply ALL
  applicable rules internally:
  - Global rules: source not vacant (VacantRule), source ≠ destination (NilMoveRule),
    within board boundaries (OutOfBoundaryRule), destination not friendly (OccupiedRule),
    and protection period check (FirstNMovesProtectionRule).
  - Piece-specific rules: Knight applies KnightMoveRule and KnightBlockRule;
    Archer applies ArcherMoveRule. A piece does NOT validate rules belonging to
    other piece types.
  Game.getAvailableMoves(player) simply iterates over all pieces belonging to the
  player, calls each piece's getAvailableMoves(game, position), and aggregates
  the results without additional filtering.
  Piece Labels: Knight displays as 'K', Archer displays as 'A'.
  Rule Validation System (Rule Implementations)
  Global Rules: Source must not be vacant (VacantRule), source and destination must differ (NilMoveRule), source and
  destination must be within board limits (OutOfBoundaryRule), and destination cannot contain a friendly piece
  (OccupiedRule).
  Protection Rule: Protection is active when game.numMoves < configuration.numMovesProtection.
  During protection, no piece can be captured (FirstNMovesProtectionRule).
  The protection phase also prevents win condition evaluation.
  Piece-Specific Rules: Knight moves must conform to its L shape and blocking constraints (KnightMoveRule,
  KnightBlockRule). Archer moves must conform to its orthogonal sliding and jumping capture constraints
  (ArcherMoveRule).
  Board Display and Coordinates
  The board uses a coordinate system where columns are labeled with letters (a, b, c, ...) and rows are labeled with
  numbers (1, 2, 3, ...), both starting from the bottom-left corner. User input format is "source->destination" (e.g.,
  "a1->b2"). Empty squares display as '.', and the central square (when empty) displays as 'x'. Pieces display with
  their color and label (e.g., a red Knight displays as a red 'K').
  Internal board representation contract: The board is stored as board[x][y] (x = column, y = row, both 0-based from
  bottom-left). Board reads should go through Game.getPiece(Place) or Game.getPiece(int x, int y). Board writes
  (e.g., in movePiece) should directly manipulate the 2D array via Game.getBoard()[x][y] = piece / null.
  There is no Game.setPiece() method. Direct indexing into board[][] is allowed for write operations in Game subclasses.
  ConsolePlayer Input Contract
  ConsolePlayer.nextMove(Game game, EList<Move> availableMoves) prompts the user
  to choose a move from the list of available (already-validated legal) moves.

  Input format: The user enters a move as a coordinate "source->destination" (e.g., "a1->b2" means moving the piece at column a, row 1
  to column b, row 2).
  Coordinate parsing rules:
  - Column letter: 'a' maps to x=0, 'b' to x=1, 'c' to x=2, etc.
  - Row number: '1' maps to y=0, '2' to y=1, '3' to y=2, etc. (1-based to 0-based)
  - Parse source and destination separately using these rules.
  Validation: After parsing, the ConsolePlayer must verify that the parsed move
  (with matching source and destination coordinates) exists in availableMoves.
  If the input is invalid (wrong format, out of bounds, source has no piece,
  move not in availableMoves, etc.), print an error message and re-prompt
  (loop until a valid coordinate input is provided).

  External Knowledge and Tools
  The following infrastructure classes and tools are already fully implemented in the project but are NOT included in
  the Ecore model. You can invoke them directly when generating code:
  MoveRecord: An independent data class that records a player and their move, with methods such as getPlayer() and
  getMove(). It is available as a utility type (not required by the current JesonMor core loop).
  InvalidConfigurationError:  Throw this when encountering invalid initialization parameters.
```
